help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How the Lore Book Forum works — quick answers to common questions
help.about_text: Lore Book Forum is a community for readers and authors: publish books and articles, keep drafts, build a personal library and discuss what you read.
help.start_1: Register or sign in — the menu at the bottom of the sidebar (⋯ More) holds the language switch and your settings.
help.start_2: The Feed shows fresh books and articles from the community; the Library lists everything published in the app.
help.start_3: Use the language switch in the same menu to read the app in English or Russian — the choice is remembered.
help.books_1: «Create a book» opens a two-step form: book details (title, genre, category, publisher, pages, ISBN, cover) and then content — annotation, author's notes, chapters and book files.
help.books_2: «Create draft» saves the book as a draft right away — you can finish it later from Drafts.
help.books_3: «Publish» additionally asks you to pick the authors and editors, then publishes the book immediately.
help.books_4: Book files: PDF, EPUB, MOBI or FB2 (one file per format, up to 100 MB each); the cover is a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
help.books_5: Open a published book and choose «Read» to read it in the built-in reader.
help.articles_1: Articles are long-read posts: write one from the article form, add a cover and publish — or keep it as a draft until it is ready.
help.drafts_1: The Drafts page collects your unfinished books and articles. Open any of them to continue where you left off.
help.saved_1: Save books you want to come back to — they appear under «Saved» in the sidebar.
help.comments_1: Discuss books and articles in comments, reply to other readers and mention them with @username — a mention links to that reader's profile.
help.profile_1: Your profile shows your publications and avatar; you can edit both from your own page.
help.support_text: Something is not working, or you have an idea to make the app better? Reach out to the moderators — feedback is always welcome.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: What data we keep, how it is used and what you control
privacy.intro_text: This policy explains what data Book App stores when you use it, why it is needed and which of it you control. It applies to the whole app: the catalogue, the feed, reading, comments and your profile.
privacy.collect_1: Account data: username, email, name and surname. Your password is stored only as a hash and can never be read back.
privacy.collect_2: Profile data: avatar, biography and the language you pick in the language switcher.
privacy.collect_3: What you create: books, articles, drafts, comments, likes, saves and reading progress.
privacy.collect_4: Files you upload: covers and book files, kept in the app's own storage.
privacy.use_1: To sign you in and keep your session, so you do not have to enter your password on every page.
privacy.use_2: To show your publications, comments and profile — to you and to other readers.
privacy.use_3: To run the app in the language you chose and to remember your choices.
privacy.share_1: Everything you publish — books, articles, comments and your public profile — is visible to other people using the app. Your email is never shown publicly.
privacy.share_2: We do not sell your data and do not pass it to advertising services.
privacy.cookies_1: Only the cookies the app needs to keep you signed in, to protect forms against CSRF and to remember your language preference. No tracking or analytics cookies are set.
privacy.rights_1: You can edit your profile, biography and avatar at any time from your own page.
privacy.rights_2: You can delete your comments and publications, and ask the moderators to block your account.
privacy.security_text: Passwords are stored hashed, uploaded files live in the app's own storage, and the admin panel is available to administrators only. If you think your data has been exposed, write to the moderators — we will look into it.
privacy.contact_text: Questions about this policy? Reach out to the moderators — the answer will come from a real person.
